name: AccelerateBS India Ltd.
summary: AccelerateBS India Ltd. is a company dedicated to guiding businesses through digital transformation. They offer an extensive range of specialized technology services to a global customer base, serving both corporate (B2B) and consumer (B2C) markets. Key services include broad digital technology solutions, expert consultation and deployment of Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), execution of various digital initiatives, creation of custom software, and professional consulting. This Mumbai, India-based firm was established in 2012.
